payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the datasets used in the experiment, including the number of articles and their sources.

claims.text: The experiment used 451 news articles from 48 news outlets, both propagandistic and non-propagandistic.
The articles were annotated according to eighteen persuasion techniques identified by professionals.
The total number of technique instances found in the articles was 7,485 out of 21,230 sentences.
